conventions.selector_chain: Ordered ancestor Style selectors exactly as written, including ^ and /template/. No assumed selector normalization or cascade evaluation.
conventions.contexts: Classes, pseudoclasses, control themes and combined states remain distinct. Conditional rules are not advertised as always active.
conventions.brush_usage: Referenced means an exact resource expression is present in runtime source, not proof that its selector matches or wins at runtime.
conventions.inherited_values: Missing setters are preserved as missing. No synthetic state-specific brushes are created; framework/application inheritance is not guessed.
conventions.null: No corresponding explicit expression exists in this source record. This is not an invented transparent value.
conventions.resolved_color: A convenience resolution of the explicit Color expression through the repository palette. Original expressions and definitions are authoritative; opacity is retained separately.
conventions.supporting_sources: Shared source files can contain other controls; only five catalog components are exported. Contextual selectors retain their owner chain.
conventions.xml_fields: Parsed XML representations preserve namespaces and order; source_files content + encoding is authoritative for original spelling, whitespace and bytes.
conventions.packaging: One self-contained JSON data document; not an executable Avalonia theme or a completed Figma current-state resolver.

source_observations.statement_ru: ToggleButton.Primary напрямую ссылается на ButtonControl*Brush. Переиспользуются сами кисти, а не только базовые цвета.
У Button сохранены dialog, Primary, Secondary, toolbar-контекст и классы ok/yes/no/cancel. Они не свёрнуты до двух вариантов.
Loading-кисти Button и TextControl объявлены в словарях, но Loading-селекторов в пяти основных файлах нет. Декларации не превращены в состояние.
TextBox при pointerover использует TextControlBorderFocusBrush; объявленный TextControlBorderHoverBrush не подставлен вместо него.
В CheckBox:checked с классом Error рамка использует CheckBoxUncheckedBorderInvalidBrush. Написание и применение сохранены без исправления.

Селектор checked+pointerover в RadioButton называет Ellipse#CheckGlyph, тогда как в его шаблоне названы InnerEllipse, ExtraEllipse и CheckEllipse. Несовпадение сохранено; эффект требует проверки Avalonia.
Для Knob в ToggleButton.SlideSwitch сохранён селектор ^ Border#Knob без /template/. Автоматического исправления селектора нет.

<ResourceDictionary xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:controls="using:Alta.Themes.Controls">

    <!-- Because Tooltip position calculations work with actual screen positions
         they don't always show up in the previewer correctly.
         In the actual app they work as intended. -->
    <Design.PreviewWith>
        <StackPanel>
            <ThemeVariantScope RequestedThemeVariant="Light">
                <Border Padding="24" Background="{DynamicResource DefaultBackgroundBrush}"
                        Width="520" Height="460">
                    <StackPanel Spacing="20">
                        <Button Classes="ArrowToolTip" ToolTip.Placement="RightEdgeAlignedBottom" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                            Information Tooltip
                            <ToolTip.Tip>
                                <controls:ArrowToolTip Severity="Info" HeaderText="Header" HintText="Hint"
                                    Text="Long text that will wrap if there is no width left in the tooltip."/>
                            </ToolTip.Tip>
                        </Button>

                        <Button Classes="ArrowToolTip" ToolTip.Placement="RightEdgeAlignedTop" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                            Error Tooltip
                            <ToolTip.Tip>
                                <controls:ArrowToolTip Severity="Info" HeaderText="Header" HintText="Hint"
                                                       Text="Long text that will wrap if there is no width left in the tooltip."/>
                            </ToolTip.Tip>
                        </Button>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Border>
            </ThemeVariantScope>
            
            <ThemeVariantScope RequestedThemeVariant="Dark">
                <Border Padding="24" Background="{DynamicResource DefaultBackgroundBrush}"
                        Width="520" Height="460">
                    <StackPanel Spacing="20">
                        <Button Classes="ArrowToolTip" ToolTip.Placement="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                            Warning Tooltip
                            <ToolTip.Tip>
                                <controls:ArrowToolTip Severity="Warning" HeaderText="Header" HintText="Hint"
                                    Text="Long text that will wrap if there is no width left in the tooltip."/>
                            </ToolTip.Tip>
                        </Button>
                        <Button Classes="ArrowToolTip" ToolTip.Placement="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                            ToolTip with custom content
                            <ToolTip.Tip>
                                <controls:ArrowToolTip MaxWidth="340">
                                    <StackPanel Spacing="10">
                                        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*">
                                            <Image Width="16" Height="16" Margin="0 1 8 0" VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                                   Source="{SvgImage /Icons/ErrorStatus.svg}" />
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" FontSize="12" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource ToolTipTextForegroundBrush}"
                                                       Text="C0020: Syntax error, unexpected '}'" />
                                        </Grid>
                                        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*">
                                            <Image Width="16" Height="16" Margin="0 1 8 0" VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                                   Source="{SvgImage /Icons/WarningStatus.svg}" />
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" FontSize="12" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource ToolTipTextForegroundBrush}"
                                                       Text="C0020: Syntax error, unexpected '}'" />
                                        </Grid>
                                        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*">
                                            <Image Width="16" Height="16" Margin="0 1 8 0" VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                                   Source="{SvgImage /Icons/InfoStatus.svg}" />
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" FontSize="12" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource ToolTipTextForegroundBrush}"
                                                       Text="C0020: Syntax error, unexpected '}' " />
                                        </Grid>
                                        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*">
                                            <Image Width="16" Height="16" Margin="0 1 8 0" VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                                   Source="{SvgImage /Icons/ToolBar_Help.svg}" />
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" FontSize="12" TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource ToolTipTextForegroundBrush}"
                                                       Text="C0020: Syntax error, unexpected '}'" />
                                        </Grid>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </controls:ArrowToolTip>
                            </ToolTip.Tip>
                        </Button>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Border>
            </ThemeVariantScope>
        </StackPanel>
    </Design.PreviewWith>
    
    <ControlTheme x:Key="{x:Type controls:ArrowToolTip}" TargetType="controls:ArrowToolTip">
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <ControlTemplate>
                <Grid x:Name="PART_MainGrid" Width="{TemplateBinding Width}" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}"
                      MinWidth="{TemplateBinding MinWidth}" MinHeight="{TemplateBinding MinHeight}" Margin="0"
                      MaxWidth="{TemplateBinding MaxWidth}" MaxHeight="{TemplateBinding MaxHeight}">

                    <Panel ZIndex="1" Margin="0 17 0 16" x:Name="ArrowLeft" IsVisible="False"
                           HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="{TemplateBinding ArrowVerticalAlignment}">
                        <Path ZIndex="3"
                              Data="M8.5 16.2929V17L0 8.5L8.5 0L8.5 0.707108L0.707107 8.5L8.5 16.2929Z"
                              Fill="{DynamicResource ToolTipBorderBrush}"
                              Stroke="{DynamicResource ToolTipBorderBrush}"
                              StrokeThickness="0.5"/>
                        <Path ZIndex="2"
                              Data="M0 8.5L9 17.5L9 0L0 8.5Z"
                              Fill="{DynamicResource ToolTipBackgroundBrush}"/>
                    </Panel>

                    <Panel ZIndex="1" Margin="0 17 0 16" x:Name="ArrowRight" IsVisible="False"
                           HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="{TemplateBinding ArrowVerticalAlignment}">
                        <Path ZIndex="3" Margin="1 0 0 0"
                              Data="M-8.9186e-07 0.707077L-9.53674e-07 0L8.5 8.5L5.32513e-07 17L4.70696e-07 16.2929L7.79289 8.5L-8.9186e-07 0.707077Z"
                              Fill="{DynamicResource ToolTipBorderBrush}"
                              Stroke="{DynamicResource ToolTipBorderBrush}"
                              StrokeThickness="0.5"/>
                        <Path ZIndex="2"
                              Data="M8.5 8.5L-9.53674e-07 0L5.32513e-07 17L9 8.5Z"
                              Fill="{DynamicResource ToolTipBackgroundBrush}"/>
                    </Panel>

                    <Panel ZIndex="1" Margin="16 0" x:Name="ArrowTop" IsVisible="False"
                           VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding ArrowHorizontalAlignment}">
                        <Path ZIndex="3"
                              Data="M0.707078 8.5H0L8.5 0L17 8.5H16.2929L8.5 0.707107L0.707078 8.5Z"
                              Fill="{DynamicResource ToolTipBorderBrush}"
                              Stroke="{DynamicResource ToolTipBorderBrush}"
                              StrokeThickness="0.5"/>
                        <Path ZIndex="2"
                              Data="M8.5 0L0 9.5H17L8.5 0Z"
                              Fill="{DynamicResource ToolTipBackgroundBrush}"/>
                    </Panel>

                    <Panel ZIndex="1" Margin="16 0" x:Name="ArrowBottom" IsVisible="False"
                           VerticalAlignment="Bottom" HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding ArrowHorizontalAlignment}">
                        <Path ZIndex="3" Margin="0 1 0 0"
                              Data="M16.2929 -8.9186e-07L17 -9.53674e-07L8.5 8.5L0 5.32513e-07L0.707108 4.70696e-07L8.5 7.79289L16.2929 -8.9186e-07Z"
                              Fill="{DynamicResource ToolTipBorderBrush}"
                              Stroke="{DynamicResource ToolTipBorderBrush}"
                              StrokeThickness="0.5"/>
                        <Path ZIndex="2"
                              Data="M8.5 9L17 0L0 0L8.5 8.5Z"
                              Fill="{DynamicResource ToolTipBackgroundBrush}"/>
                    </Panel>

                    <Border x:Name="PART_MainContent"
                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                            Background="{DynamicResource ToolTipBackgroundBrush}"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ToolTipBorderBrush}"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            Margin="0"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            Padding="12"
                            ZIndex="0">
                        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*">
                            <Panel Height="16" Width="16" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="0 1 6 0" Grid.Column="0"
                                   IsVisible="{TemplateBinding Severity, Converter={x:Static ObjectConverters.IsNotNull}}">
                                <Image x:Name="ErrorIcon" IsVisible="False" Source="{SvgImage /Icons/ErrorStatus.svg}"/>
                                <Image x:Name="WarningIcon" IsVisible="False" Source="{SvgImage /Icons/WarningStatus.svg}"/>
                                <Image x:Name="InfoIcon" IsVisible="False" Source="{SvgImage /Icons/InfoStatus.svg}"/>
                                <Image x:Name="SuccessIcon" IsVisible="False" Source="{SvgImage /Icons/SuccessStatus.svg}"/>
                            </Panel>
                            
                            <StackPanel Orientation="Vertical" Spacing="8" Grid.Column="1">
                                <TextBlock Text="{TemplateBinding HeaderText}" FontWeight="600" FontSize="12"
                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource ToolTipTextForegroundBrush}"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap" x:Name="PART_HeaderText" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                           IsVisible="{TemplateBinding HeaderText, Converter={x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}}"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{TemplateBinding Text}" Foreground="{DynamicResource ToolTipTextForegroundBrush}"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap" x:Name="PART_MainText" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                           IsVisible="{TemplateBinding Text, Converter={x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}}"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{TemplateBinding HintText}" Foreground="{DynamicResource ToolTipHintTextForegroundBrush}"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap" x:Name="PART_HintText" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                           IsVisible="{TemplateBinding HintText, Converter={x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}}"/>
                                <ContentPresenter x:Name="PART_ContentPresenter"
                                                  Content="{TemplateBinding Content}"
                                                  ContentTemplate="{TemplateBinding ContentTemplate}"
                                                  HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                                                  IsVisible="{TemplateBinding Content, Converter={x:Static ObjectConverters.IsNotNull}}"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>
                    </Border>

                    <Grid.Styles>
                        <Style Selector="Grid#PART_MainGrid">
                            <Setter Property="IsVisible">
                                <MultiBinding  Converter="{x:Static BoolConverters.Or}">
                                    <Binding Path="HeaderText" RelativeSource="{RelativeSource TemplatedParent}"
                                        Converter="{x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}"/>
                                    <Binding Path="Text" RelativeSource="{RelativeSource TemplatedParent}"
                                        Converter="{x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}"/>
                                    <Binding Path="HintText" RelativeSource="{RelativeSource TemplatedParent}"
                                        Converter="{x:Static StringConverters.IsNotNullOrEmpty}"/>
                                    <Binding Path="Content" RelativeSource="{RelativeSource TemplatedParent}"
                                        Converter="{x:Static ObjectConverters.IsNotNull}"/>
                                </MultiBinding>
                            </Setter>
                        </Style>
                    </Grid.Styles>
                </Grid>
            </ControlTemplate>
        </Setter>

        <Style Selector="^[Position=Left]">
            <Style Selector="^ Panel#ArrowRight">
                <Setter Property="IsVisible" Value="True"/>
            </Style>
            <Style Selector="^ Border#PART_MainContent">
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0 0 8 0"/>
            </Style>
        </Style>

        <Style Selector="^[Position=Right]">
            <Style Selector="^ Panel#ArrowLeft">
                <Setter Property="IsVisible" Value="True"/>
            </Style>
            <Style Selector="^ Border#PART_MainContent">
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="8 0 0 0"/>
            </Style>
        </Style>

        <Style Selector="^[Position=Bottom]">
            <Style Selector="^ Panel#ArrowTop">
                <Setter Property="IsVisible" Value="True"/>
            </Style>
            <Style Selector="^ Border#PART_MainContent">
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0 8 0 0"/>
            </Style>
        </Style>

        <Style Selector="^[Position=Top]">
            <Style Selector="^ Panel#ArrowBottom">
                <Setter Property="IsVisible" Value="True"/>
            </Style>
            <Style Selector="^ Border#PART_MainContent">
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0 0 0 8"/>

        </Style>

        <Style Selector="^[Severity=Info]">

        <Style Selector="^[Severity=Error]">

        <Style Selector="^[Severity=Warning]">
